The source identifies the five-speed ZF gearbox. The cockpit photograph shows a driver-operated manual lever beside the driver; the selector gate itself is not readable. An H-pattern driver-shifted gearbox requires declutching to pull away from rest under the project's derivation. Manual blip is modeled as a downshift action. Automatic blip is modeled as a downshift action. Throttle lift is modeled for upshift technique here. No downshift cut action is part of this model's action vocabulary. The inspected Type 25 cockpit photo shows a conventional continuous round leather-bound rim. All visible instruments are separate dashboard gauges; none is carried on the rim. No wheel-mounted shift lights are visible. The photographed rim is closed and continuous.
